hooks.text: Two continent-sized blobs of an alien planet are buried deep inside Earth.
A Mars-sized world vaporized our infant Earth four point five billion years ago.
Earth swallowed another planet whole, and its ancient heart is still down there.

title: The Alien World Buried Inside Earth
description: Discover how a collision with a Mars-sized planet named Theia formed our Moon and left continent-sized remnants deep inside Earth's mantle.

beats.text: Four point five billion years ago, a Mars-sized world named Theia smashed into our infant Earth.

beats.text: Recent high-resolution simulations reveal this cataclysmic impact could have formed the Moon in just a few hours.

beats.text: But Theia did not vanish entirely into space.
